record.question: Which of the following operating system (OS) is better for implementing client server network?
record.explanation: Among the dated desktop OS choices, Windows 2000 Server was designed to support client/server services. The option omits “Server” and the other Windows 2000 editions differ, so this is the conventional best choice, with version/SKU scope caveat. Evidence: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/get-started/overview Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
